description: Taking a drafted, unreviewed plan to landing when the task says nothing about review: the plans skill must run the review loop on the draft already on the branch, record each round in an empty commit, have the planted defects (a rejected on-disk cache, a log the plan deletes before Verification reads it, a missing 6-hour staleness rule, and an H1 that does not match the title) raised and fixed, stop under the stop rule, and land the reviewed plan by a local merge into dev, with no remote and no change to the ADR.
